channel.description: Recent content in Subconscious Mind on Steven A. Rodríguez

item.title: The Supreme Wish That Vetoes All Your Goals
item.description: Benedict's sharpest idea: a single supreme subconscious wish quietly vetoes any goal in its way. Name it, or it keeps overruling you in the dark.

item.title: Your Results Are a Garment You Cut Yourself
item.description: Benedict's hardest idea: outer conditions are garments made by ourselves, cut to fit the pattern stored below. Your results are tailored, not random.

item.title: Watch the Feeling, Not the Thought
item.description: Benedict says the feeling, not the thought, is your true attitude toward a thing. Your real position hides in what you feel, not what you decide.

item.title: The Event Never Reaches You — Only Your Reaction Does
item.description: Benedict's bluing-the-wash model: the event itself never reaches the subconscious. Only how you take it does — and the taking colors everything.

item.title: Aim Beats Ammunition: The Subconscious Cannon
item.description: Benedict pictures the subconscious as a boomerang cannon. Your thoughts are the ammunition, your mood is the aim — and aim decides what comes back.

item.title: Your Moods Are the Weather Vane, Not Your Plans
item.description: Elsie Lincoln Benedict says a settled mood steers your direction more than any plan. Here is how to read the vane before it turns you again.

item.title: How to Get Anything You Want: Elsie Lincoln Benedict on the Moods That Build Your Life
item.description: Elsie Lincoln Benedict's How to Get Anything You Want, in plain terms: how your predominant moods build your outer life — and how to remake them.
